caption:
Momo is on her feet all day, trimming stems and wrapping bouquets, and by closing time her wrists and calves feel heavy.

Repeating the same cutting and tying movements, and standing for hours, can leave muscles tired and tense. Swapping between tasks and half-filling buckets may help share the load. Remedial massage can be a helpful sidekick, easing tight muscles as part of your recovery.

Hybi's tip: stretch your wrists both ways for 15 seconds each, and stand on a cushioned mat for long shifts.

Hand numbness or weakness, or a swollen, warm wrist, is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
